sources.title: Aditya Birla Fashion Acquires 15.62% Stake in Imperial Online, Raising Ownership to 100%

synopsis: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited's digital-first subsidiary, Aditya Birla Digital Fashion Ventures Limited, has acquired the remaining 15.62% equity stake in Imperial Online Services Private Limited, raising its ownership from 84.38% to 100%. Imperial Online Services owns the fast-growing fashion brand Urbano. The milestone-linked cash transaction has successfully closed, completing a full buyout under a pre-defined agreement from July 11, 2022. The target entity reported a turnover of 119.38 crore Indian Rupees for the financial year ending March 31, 2026. The acquisition requires no government or regulatory approvals and was executed via cash consideration.
